title: Say when an item is missing
summary: Express.js: Say when an item is missing. Use curl -i to inspect the 404 status too.
introduction: A status code tells the client what happened. GET /books/99 returns 404 because this practice item is absent.
learningObjectives: Say when an item is missing with Express.js
Use curl -i to inspect the 404 status too

blocks.text: In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install express@5. Save one example as server.mjs and run node server.mjs. Use the stated URL on http://127.0.0.1:3000; stop with Ctrl+C before another example.
